entries.1adaff828bdaacd5: Through its construction business, the company aims to contribute to creating a more livable living environment and a rich society. It lists "maintenance and renewal of social capital," "disaster prevention and mitigation," "energy and environment," "medical care," and "PPP and PFI" as focus fields, actively uses construction ICT (information-based construction) and AI (artificial intelligence) to strive for labor saving and improvement of labor productivity, and aims to be a company where diverse human resources can play an active role. In the medium-term management plan covering the 3 years from the 81st fiscal period to the 83rd fiscal period, it sets as its aspired form becoming a "first-call company" and other goals, and while continuing investment in securing and developing human resources, works to improve comprehensive competitiveness in technology, quality, and price.
